text_en: Thus says the Lord : Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
text_cn: 上主这样说：“你下到犹大王宫去，在那里宣布这话，

text_en: and say: Hear the word of the Lord , O King of Judah sitting on the throne of David—you, and your servants, and your people who enter these gates.
text_cn: 说：坐在达味宝座上的犹大王！你和你的臣仆及从这些门进来的人民，该聆听上主的话。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Act with justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor anyone who has been robbed. And do no wrong or violence to the alien, the orphan, and the widow, or shed innocent blood in this place.
text_cn: 上主这样说：你们应执行公道正义，从压迫人的手中解救受剥夺的人，不要伤害虐待外方人和孤儿寡妇，不要在这地方上流无辜者的血。

text_en: For if you will indeed obey this word, then through the gates of this house shall enter kings who sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their servants, and their people.
text_cn: 假使你们实在照这话去做，必有坐在达味宝座上的君王，乘车骑马，与自己的臣仆和人民从这宫殿的门进来；

text_en: But if you will not heed these words, I swear by myself, says the Lord , that this house shall become a desolation.
text_cn: 倘若你们不听从这话，我指着自己起誓──上主的断语──这宫殿必要变为废墟。

text_en: For thus says the Lord concerning the house of the king of Judah: You are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon; but I swear that I will make you a desert, an uninhabited city.
text_cn: 因为上主这样论犹大王的宫殿说：即使你为我有如基肋阿得，又如黎巴嫩的山顶，我仍要使你变为荒野，成为无人居住的城市；

text_en: I will prepare destroyers against you, all with their weapons; they shall cut down your choicest cedars and cast them into the fire.
text_cn: 我要祝圣那已武装的毁灭者来攻击你，砍伐你最佳美的香柏，投入火中。

text_en: And many nations will pass by this city, and all of them will say one to another, “Why has the Lord dealt in this way with that great city? ”
text_cn: 许多民族经过这城时，必互相问说：为什么上主这样对待了这座大城市？

text_en: And they will answer, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshiped other gods and served them. ”
text_cn: 人必答说：因为他们废弃了上主他们的天主的盟约，敬拜事奉了别的神祇。”

text_en: Do not weep for him who is dead, nor bemoan him; weep rather for him who goes away, for he shall return no more to see his native land.
text_cn: 你们不要为已死的人哭泣，不要为他举哀；却要为远去的人痛哭，因为他不会再回来，见他的生身地。

text_en: For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of King Josiah of Judah, who succeeded his father Josiah, and who went away from this place: He shall return here no more,
text_cn: 因为上主这样论犹大王约史雅的儿子，即继承他父亲约史雅为王的沙隆说：“他一离开这地方，就不会再回来，

text_en: but in the place where they have carried him captive he shall die, and he shall never see this land again.
text_cn: 必死在被掳去的地方，不会再见此地。”

text_en: Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms by injustice; who makes his neighbors work for nothing, and does not give them their wages;
text_cn: 祸哉，那不以公道正义建筑自己的宫殿楼台，叫人为自己徒劳而不给他工资的人！

text_en: who says, “I will build myself a spacious house with large upper rooms, ” and who cuts out windows for it, paneling it with cedar, and painting it with vermilion.
text_cn: 他说：我得给自己建筑广大的宫殿，宽敞的楼台，开设窗户，镶上香柏，涂上丹砂。

text_en: Are you a king because you compete in cedar? Did not your father eat and drink and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
text_cn: 你为王是要以香柏争胜吗？你父亲岂不也吃也喝？但他执行公道正义，为此能一切顺利；

text_en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Is not this to know me? says the Lord .
text_cn: 他亲自裁判弱小和贫苦人的案件，因此一切顺利；这岂不是表示他认识我？──上主的断语──

text_en: But your eyes and heart are only on your dishonest gain, for shedding innocent blood, and for practicing oppression and violence.
text_cn: 至于你，你的眼和心，只顾私利，只知流无辜者的血，施行欺压和勒索。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah: They shall not lament for him, saying, “Alas, my brother! ” or “Alas, sister! ” They shall not lament for him, saying, “Alas, lord! ” or “Alas, his majesty! ”
text_cn: 为此上主这样说：“对于犹大王约史雅的儿子约雅金，人必不哀悼他说：哀哉，我兄弟！或哀哉，我姊妹！人必不哀悼他说：哀哉，主上！或哀哉，陛下！

text_en: With the burial of a donkey he shall be buried— dragged off and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 人要埋葬他如同埋葬一匹死驴，将他拖出，抛在耶路撒冷的门外。”

text_en: Go up to Lebanon, and cry out, and lift up your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are crushed.
text_cn: 你该上黎巴嫩去呼喊，在巴商提高你的声音，由阿巴陵喊叫，因为你的情侣都已灭亡。

text_en: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, “I will not listen. ” This has been your way from your youth, for you have not obeyed my voice.
text_cn: 在你欢乐时，我曾劝告过你，你却说：“我不听从。”你从幼年，就是这般行径，从不听我的声音。

text_en: The wind shall shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity; then you will be ashamed and dismayed because of all your wickedness.
text_cn: 你所有的牧人将被风卷去，你的情侣必流徙（xǐ）远方；那时你必因你行的一切邪恶，含羞抱愧。

text_en: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nested among the cedars, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain as of a woman in labor!
text_cn: 你现在住在黎巴嫩，在香柏树上营巢，但是，当痛苦，像产妇的痛苦袭击你时，你将多么可怜！

text_en: As I live, says the Lord , even if King Coniah son of Jehoiakim of Judah were the signet ring on my right hand, even from there I would tear you off
text_cn: 我永在──上主的断语──犹大王约雅金的儿子苛尼雅，即便你是我右手上盖章的指环，我也要将你拔除，

text_en: and give you into the hands of those who seek your life, into the hands of those of whom you are afraid, even into the hands of King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon and into the hands of the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 交在图谋你性命和你畏惧的人的手中，交在巴比伦王拿步高和加色丁人的手中；

text_en: I will hurl you and the mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born, and there you shall die.
text_cn: 将你和你生身的母亲，抛在不是你们出生的异地，叫你们死在那里。

text_en: But they shall not return to the land to which they long to return.
text_cn: 他们必不能回到他心灵渴望回去的地方。

text_en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken pot, a vessel no one wants? Why are he and his offspring hurled out and cast away in a land that they do not know?
text_cn: 苛尼雅这人，不是个可鄙而该毁灭的器皿，或无人喜悦的家具吗？为什么他和他的后裔被抛弃，被投掷到自己不相识的地方去？

text_en: O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord !
text_cn: 地啊！地啊！地啊！请聆听上主的话！

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Record this man as childless, a man who shall not succeed in his days; for none of his offspring shall succeed in sitting on the throne of David, and ruling again in Judah.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“你应记录：这人是一个无子女，毕生无成就的人，因为他的后裔中，没有一人能成功，能坐上达味的宝座，再统治犹大。”
